Vouching of Credit Side of Cash Book (or) Cash Payments. The auditor vouches cash payments with an objective to ensure that all cash payments pertaining to business activities are genuine and properly authorized.

All payments as far as possible, except for petty cash, should be made by cheques or online. If large amounts appear to have been paid in cash, contrary to the usual practice of the business, auditor must ascertain the circumstances in which it was considered necessary.

All the payment made to creditors, expenses incurred in cash and all other payments done appear on the credit side of cash book and the Auditor is required to vouch cash payments because chances of cash misappropriation are very high.
